specs.title: AI Readiness: Product Specs & Schema.org
tabTemplates:
Official pages

Exact official product pages, official family pages, No Defensible Pages, ambiguous matches, and unchecked listings stay separate. A family page is not an exact product page.

Amazon attribute completeness

Amazon attribute completeness averages {spec_avg_amazon_pct} across the checked listings in this catalog spec read. Official-page outcomes are on the Findability tab. Machine-readable specs on found {brand_site} pages are on Brand-Site Specs.

What is Schema.org, and why does AI need it?
When people visit {brand_site}, they read marketing copy. AI crawlers need Schema.org JSON-LD to take a spec as a fact. The spec block is the part of that product data that can carry neck, pickup, and hardware specs. The missing-field rows on this tab are the latest {brand_site} page read.
What is Amazon A+ content, and why does it win AI queries?
Comparison tables have not been measured. A+ Content is the enhanced modules on a product page: graphics, diagrams, and comparison charts. When a comparison table is on the page, Amazon's shopping assistant and other AI models can read the columns and repeat how the lineup steps up.
